title: Evernote(WindowsApp) XSS to RCE
vulnerabilityInformation: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability was reported in the Windows version of the Evernote application. Malformed ENEX note files containing an HTML-encoded payload in the clipped-source-title attribute triggered script execution when imported. The injected script used the application's IPC bridge to launch a local executable, resulting in arbitrary program execution on the host system.
